title: Cross-fitted surface-free residual datum/trend action
hypothesis: A compact split-trained ridge model can use legal geometry, visible-prefix, E006, and E007 evidence to learn a bounded signed residual action that improves E006 without E007's fixed-placement shift failures.

design.model: deterministic multi-output ridge residual datum/trend action
legal_inputs: target-independent E007 self-correlation path and diagnostics
forbidden_inputs: hidden TVT at inference or outside the applicable training split
direct typewell features or typewell identity
targets: centered end-to-end residual trend around E006
design.promotion: A candidate must improve E006 by at least 0.05 RMSE, win at least four maps and 17 outer cells, satisfy tail and special-slice limits, improve every spatial/typewell evaluator group, pass all parent/leakage/shuffle/ablation/stability/runtime controls, and reproduce independently.
design.deployment: Package and private offline Kaggle parity only after statistical promotion. No leaderboard submission is authorized.
